items.title: Canvas has no touch-action and the page uses 100vh, so mobile browsers pan/zoom the game and the bottom bar hides under browser chrome
No in-game list of the key bindings or what a click does
Controls panel covers the top strip at 1042x508: opened from the Controls button, it sits over Shop, Scoreboard and Controls, and its Close ...
A selection over 12 units shows 12 tiles and no hint that more are selected
One left click on an inventory item sells it, with no confirm and no label
Panel offsets are magic numbers tied to a 160/120px bottom bar and a 246px left column; landscape phones get the desktop layout
widgets.js and modui.js still place panels with fixed pixel offsets
Loading shows only a status string; the screen is blank dark until the world builds
Host cannot remove a bot or kick a seat once filled
Minimap presses move the camera on any button including right click, canvas lacks touch-action and keyboard access
modui polls with setInterval and no in-flight guard, so a slow reply makes duplicate messages
Phone lobby hero grid overflows the 390px width (panels.lua portraits, widgets portrait grid)
Phone lobby forces 8 fixed 56px columns and a 267px-tall modal, so the hero grid overflows sideways
At 390x844 the right-side shop panel is clipped on its left edge: the heading reads 'hop gold 1007' and the first card reads 'ad...', so the...
Phone UI uses 8-9px text and 20-26px touch targets
Portraits items carry no tone, so held heroes lost the faint tone when the acronym badge replaced the name
The refusal line (bottom:12%) sits under the 160px bottom bar and has no z-index
Selection panel mana line prints max mana, not current/max
Shop and scoreboard open only by keyboard key, so touch players cannot reach them
#status shows per-order debug lines and hashes, and the next write erases fatal errors
Team is Team A/B in the lobby, Team 0/1 on the scoreboard and 'side N wins' at the end; win panel has no action
Own/ally/enemy is told by green/blue/red alone on bars and minimap
Buttons with a tip get aria-label = tip, so the accessible name drops the visible text
A changed panel tree replaces all children, so keyboard focus and scroll position reset
unit_rules.lua caches applied values per unit slot, so a reused slot can keep the defaults
An ability that is not learned can be cast: check the skill-up gate in the sim and the controls
The page reads unit state through seven separate exports that each rescan every unit
widgets.js badge doc comment still says centred behind; a correction line sits under it
Debug API seats bots and starts a match for an in-match witness, localhost only
